items.source: Note that this will be invoked only if preSend(Message, MessageChannel) successfully completed and returned a Message, i.e. it did not return null.
items.translation: 请注意，仅当preSend(Message, MessageChannel)成功完成并返回一个 Message（即未返回null）时才会调用此方法。

items.source: Note that this will be invoked only if preReceive(MessageChannel) successfully completed and returned true.
items.translation: 请注意，仅当preReceive(MessageChannel)成功完成并返回true时才会调用此方法。

items.source: Interface for interceptors that are able to view and/or modify the Messages being sent-to and/or received-from a MessageChannel.
items.translation: 用于拦截器（interceptors）的接口，这些拦截器能够查看和/或修改发送到和/或从消息通道（MessageChannel）接收的消息（Messages）。

items.source: Invoked before the Message is actually sent to the channel. This allows for modification of the Message if necessary. If this method returns null then the actual send invocation will not occur.
items.translation: 在消息实际发送到通道之前被调用。 这允许在必要时修改消息。 如果此方法返回 `null`，则不会执行实际的发送调用。

items.source: Invoked immediately after a Message has been retrieved but before it is returned to the caller. The Message may be modified if necessary; null aborts further interceptor invocations. This only applies to PollableChannels.
items.translation: 在从通道检索到消息但尚未返回给调用者之前立即被调用。如有必要，可以修改该消息；`null` 会中止后续的拦截器调用。此规则仅适用于可轮询通道（PollableChannels）。

items.source:
Invoked immediately after the send invocation. The boolean
value argument represents the return value of that invocation.
items.translation: 在发送调用后立即被调用。布尔值参数代表该调用的返回值。

items.source:
Invoked as soon as receive is called and before a Message is
actually retrieved. If the return value is 'false', then no
Message will be retrieved. This only applies to PollableChannels.
items.translation: 在调用 `receive` 后立即被调用，且在实际检索到 `Message` 之前。如果返回值为 `'false'`，则不会检索到任何 `Message`。此规则仅适用于 `PollableChannels`。

items.source:
Invoked after the completion of a receive regardless of any exception that
have been raised thus allowing for proper resource cleanup.
items.translation: 在接收完成之后被调用，无论是否已引发任何异常，从而允许进行适当的资源清理。

items.source:
Invoked after the completion of a send regardless of any exception that
have been raised thus allowing for proper resource cleanup.
items.translation: 在发送完成后被调用，无论是否已抛出任何异常，从而允许正确清理资源。

items.source:
Invoked immediately after a Message has been retrieved but before
it is returned to the caller.
items.translation: 在从消息队列中检索到消息但尚未返回给调用者之前立即被调用。

items.source: Invoked immediately after the send invocation.
items.translation: 在发送调用后立即被调用。

items.source:
Invoked as soon as receive is called and before a Message is
actually retrieved.
items.translation: 在调用 `receive` 后立即被调用，且在实际检索消息之前。

items.source: Invoked before the Message is actually sent to the channel.
items.translation: 在消息实际发送到通道之前被调用。
